description:
Reef: Stay Focused and Boost Productivity
Reef is your ultimate productivity companion, designed to help you stay focused, manage screentime, and minimize distractions. Whether you’re working, studying, or simply want to disconnect from unnecessary distractions, Reef empowers you to take control of your time and focus on what matters.
Note: We use Accessibility Service to know when you are using unproductive apps and close them automatically. No information leaves your device, nor is it distributed to any third parties.
Key Features:
• Focus Mode: Enter focus mode to pause distracting apps and stay productive. Once your focus session is over, all apps resume automatically, letting you get back to them without interruption.
• Routine Scheduling: Set up daily or weekly routines to automatically activate focus mode during specific times. Whether it’s work hours, study sessions, or personal time, Reef adapts to your schedule.
• App Whitelist: Customize your focus sessions by whitelisting essential apps that you still need access to, even during focus mode. Keep important tools available while pausing distractions.
• App Usage Limits: Set daily limits for apps and receive reminders when you’re nearing your limit. Manage how much time you spend on social media, games, or any other apps that distract you.
• Pause & Resume: With a single tap, pause apps during focus mode and resume them effortlessly when you’re done. This simple control helps you manage distractions with ease.
• Digital Well-being: Reef helps improve your digital well-being by promoting healthy app usage habits. Cut down on screen time and reclaim your focus to achieve your goals.
• Personalized Experience: Tailor your focus settings to your lifestyle. Whether you want to focus for a few minutes or a few hours, Reef adapts to your needs.
Why Choose Reef?
In a world filled with distractions, Reef helps you regain control over your time and attention. Whether you’re studying, working, or just need a break from constant notifications, Reef is the perfect tool to boost your productivity and maintain a healthy balance between your digital life and your real-world responsibilities.
Take control of your time, eliminate distractions, and achieve more with Reef!
